newsitem.title: USA: Houston Exploration IPO priced at $15.50.
newsitem.headline: Houston Exploration IPO priced at $15.50.

text.p: Houston Exploration Co said late on Thursday that its initial public offering of 7,130,000 shares of common stock was priced at $15.50 per share.

The number of shares includes the underwriters' overallotment option. To the public, the company was offering 6.2 million shares at an estimated price range of $13 to $15 per share, according to a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
Previously, Houston Exploration planned to offer 5.7 million shares in a range of $13 to $14 per share.
The company is a unit of Brooklyn Union Gas Co. Upon completion of the offering, the company said that Brooklyn Union will own about 66 percent of its outstanding shares.
Net proceeds of the offering will be used to repay outstanding indebtedness and to finance the purchase of natural gas and oil properties, the company said.
The lead underwriter on the offering is Goldman Sachs & Co.
